style="text-align:left;line-height:1.2;">WITH&nbsp;CustomerTotals&nbsp;AS&nbsp;(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;SELECT<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c.CustomerID,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;c.FirstName,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COUNT(o.OrderID)&nbsp;AS&nbsp;OrderCount,<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;COALESCE(SUM(o.TotalAmount),&nbsp;0)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;AS&nbsp;TotalAmount<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;FROM&nbsp;CUSTOMERS&nbsp;AS&nbsp;c<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;LEFT&nbsp;JOIN&nbsp;ORDERS&nbsp;AS&nbsp;o<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ON&nbsp;c.CustomerID&nbsp;=&nbsp;o.CustomerID<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;GROUP&nbsp;BY&nbsp;c.CustomerID,&nbsp;c.FirstName<br>)<br>SELECT&nbsp;FirstName,&nbsp;OrderCount,&nbsp;TotalAmount<br>FROM&nbsp;CustomerTotals<br>WHERE&nbsp;TotalAmount&nbsp;&gt;=&nbsp;400<br>ORDER&nbsp;BY&nbsp;TotalAmount&nbsp;DESC,&nbsp;CustomerID;</div>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;fontSize=12;fontStyle=0;strokeWidth=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontFamily=Courier New;spacingTop=8;spacingLeft=8;" parent="1" vertex="1"> div.div:
SELECT
c.CustomerID,
c.FirstName,
o.OrderDate
FROM CUSTOMERS AS c
INNER JOIN ORDERS AS o
ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
ORDER BY
c.CustomerID,
o.OrderDate;
